distractors: A number the team is formally measured against, agreed at the start of the period and not reopened inside it.
A projection produced from historical data by a model, so that nobody's judgement has to be defended and nobody's name sits on the answer.
A deliberately conservative number used for planning, pitched low enough that it can be beaten, so that whoever quotes it is never the person explaining a shortfall later on.

A range with an explicit confidence level attached, so that the reader can see how much of the spread is genuine uncertainty and how much of it is the modeller hedging. Precision about the doubt is the entire product.

A decision taken quickly on incomplete information because waiting for the rest of it would cost more than being wrong does. What is being praised is the timing, and whoever takes it is expected to revisit it as the rest of the picture arrives.
